en:
//　くつくつ、と笑う。
  She chuckles.

//　あくまで。
  After all this―

//　親切な注釈が、実行者から入った。 Her hand lowered, Hikaru turns to face me once more. Her tone is casual, matter-
of-fact. I suppose that she would know.

//　湊斗光の<RUBY text='ゆめ'>深層</RUBY>である存在は、湊斗光の<RUBY text='ゆめ'>悲願</RUBY>を叫んだ。
  With heat enough to fuel a star, Hikaru speaks the dream that made her.

//　小指で触れてくるような呼ばわりに、上から被せる。
  She speaks my name softly, a gentle, probing gesture. I move quickly to the next question.
